catalog_name: Roblox Luau Assistant external reference catalog

sources.title: Roblox Engine API reference
sources.summary: Reference for Roblox Engine classes, data types, enums, globals, libraries, properties, methods, events, and callbacks. Use as the primary authority for current API surface and behavior.

sources.title: Luau
sources.summary: Overview of Luau as Roblox Studio's scripting language, including gradual typing, language behavior, and Script Editor support.

sources.title: Type checking
sources.summary: Current guidance for annotations, inference modes, unions, intersections, generics, type exports, casts, and Roblox-specific types.

sources.title: Scripting
sources.summary: Roblox scripting overview and Luau fundamentals, including local scope, tables, iteration, and common script concepts.

sources.title: Script types and locations
sources.summary: Explains Script, LocalScript, execution location, Script.RunContext, and how placement affects server/client behavior and access.

sources.title: Reuse code
sources.summary: Guidance for reusing code with ModuleScripts across the same side or client-server boundary, including common placement patterns.

sources.title: Remote events and callbacks
sources.summary: Defines RemoteEvent, UnreliableRemoteEvent, and RemoteFunction communication across the client-server boundary and their yielding/reliability characteristics.

sources.title: Securing the client-server boundary
sources.summary: Server-side validation guidance for client-triggered actions, including remote inputs and client-triggered instances.

sources.title: Data stores
sources.summary: Current DataStoreService usage, server-only access, persistent storage concepts, Studio access considerations, and related cloud services.

sources.title: Best practices for data stores
sources.summary: Current guidance on organizing data stores and keys, lifecycle management, versions, MemoryStore use, and scalable data practices.

sources.title: Parallel Luau
sources.summary: Current Parallel Luau programming model, Actors, parallel execution, and performance/safety considerations for workloads such as NPCs and procedural generation.

sources.title: Network ownership
sources.summary: Explains distributed physics, BasePart and assembly ownership, SetNetworkOwner, responsiveness, performance, and security implications.

sources.title: How to use Parallel Luau
sources.summary: Community tutorial showing practical Actor-based Parallel Luau setup and conceptual examples. Treat as supplemental and defer to current Creator Hub documentation if details differ.

sources.title: How To Use, Utilize, and Succeed with DataStores
sources.summary: Community tutorial discussing DataStore usage, request efficiency, organization, and practical implementation considerations. Verify all API details against current official documentation.

sources.title: Single Script Architecture and Modular Programming
sources.summary: Community discussion/tutorial on organizing Roblox projects with entry scripts and ModuleScripts, including maintainability considerations. Treat architectural recommendations as optional patterns, not rules.

sources.title: Code Framework and Structure
sources.summary: Community code-review discussion covering modular server/client structure, UI modules, initialization, and framework organization. Use only for practical patterns and defer to official API documentation.

sources.title: DataStores Access and Storage Updates
